triangle_set.note: Boolean: the supplied vertex set has exactly three vertices and is a clique (cardinality first). K_3 qualifies; K_4 and three edgeless vertices do not.

triangle.note: Prop: clique T /\ #|T| = 3 (clique first), reflected by triangleP; the cardinality-first order is triangle_card_firstE.

raw_pairs.note: Every two-element subset of the supplied set, adjacent or not: C(#|T|,2) pairs, none below two vertices; graph edges only under a clique guard (raw_pairs_cliqueE).
